lines: Vena's voice lines and sound effects.
- Vena: "THIS is what we travelled back for? This write-off is your father? Very well. Let us show him what a mistake it was to choose Sirius."

- Vena: "How? HOW? Does it matter? We're here. Orion - daddy doesn't recognize you. Some meddler has trapped us in an eternal death-dance, murdering each other, over and over. But we finally found you - alive. We retreat now, and hide. Find us, daddy dearest."
- Vena: "What? Oh? A FIGHT? Do you not approve of your future DAUGHTER-IN-LAW?"
- Vena: "We arrived at the exact right time. We kill Sirius and keep daddy alive. Bring him back with us. Cephalon Parvos paid good credits to make me—"
- "The Marrowbone is armed and hungry for blood. Let's go."
- "The key to successful piracy is practice. Let's go get some."
- "Orion says we're raiding Ryoku, so we're doing it. You in or out?"
- "I don't crew with faint hearts. Come with me, and we'll get shit done."
- "I only stop raiding that asshole's ship when Orion says so. And he didn't say so."
- "You know how much the old man misses the war. Let's put on a show."
- "Orion needs a gift. I know just the place!"
- "Wanna go raid the Scoria's Angel? Ryoku won't mind. Well, he will, but who cares?"
- "Come on! The old man's falling asleep! Let's go make some noise!"
- "I need to cause some havoc or I'll start clawing up the walls. You in?"
- "It's playtime. I wanna show Orion I can still rule the skies."
- "The Marrowbone. She'll feel familiar to you, but she's all mine. Couldn't have found you without her. She may be more powerful than what you're used to."
- "Rapid fire. Rapid movement. Unlimited munitions. The Marrowbone is rigged to intercept and maul. Just like me."
- "What Orion wants, he gets. And Orion wants me to practice. If Ryoku winds up skewered on my blades, it's an accident. Simply tragic."

- "Old Hunhow needs a little excitement, and what's more exciting than blood sport? Today we're going to find a way onto Ryoku's capital ship. Then, we're going to bleed him until he screams and screams. And screams."
- "I'm sick of Pontis Tower. I crave battle. Ryoku, you better be ready. We're coming."
- "Ryoku desires a challenge to please old man Hunhow. I desire blood. His. We will slice up his operation and then we will cut down the Yaiba himself.""
- "These Security Nodes act as Ryoku's eyes. Claw them out."
- "Take out those security nodes. Ryoku already knows we're coming. Don't let him see from where."
- "Emergency! Specters! In Ryoku's image. Consider this a practice run."
- "What's this? Another Scoria trick? Deal with them."
- "Corpus intruders on deck. Cut them down."
- "Corpus elites incoming. They'll bleed just the same."
- "We've been breached. Corpus units, the expensive ones."
- "Intruders! Wait... is that... a Sister of Parvos? Not on my ship."
- "Disease bags incoming. Lance these wretched boils."
- "Ramsleds! That sneaky bastard is working with Grineer. Slice them up."
- "Nothing left of the intruders but a disgusting mess. Wonderful."
- "Intruders cut down. Oh, how I love a good mess."
- "Is that all? I was just getting started."
- "All clear. Crew, back to your stations!"
- "Get on those turrets, crew! Slice them out of the sky."
- "Supply transports marked. Blast their cargo but leave the ships intact."
- "Supply Transports. Destroy their cargo and send them running."
- "First cargo destroyed. Pilot panic will be setting in soon."
- "Look at that. Right back to home. Predictable fools. Mark a course to that waypoint."
- "As predicted, they've fled right to a massive cloaking signature. Hit it with the forward artillery, let's see what's on the other side."
- "Look, a cloaked vessel. Give it a love tap with the forward artillery, tell it to come out and play."
- "Well, well. Ryoku's comet shredder. This is how he's supplying his units. Tenno, prepare for boarding."
- "Now it's our turn to do some breaching. Shall we?"
- "Tenno, be kind and put these worthless mercs out of their misery before I do."
- "No fair. I get stuck with the desk job; you get to kill them all."
- "Tell those bloodbags to shut up! I'm trying to concentrate."
- "Keep fighting. I've just found something very interesting."
- "It's our house now. Unlock every door they have."
- "Oh Ryoku, what was yours is now ours."
- "We're in full control. You know, I've always wanted a comet shredder."
- "What do we have here? Ship's Captain? Finally, a challenge."
- "Here comes the head of the ship. Decapitate him."
- "A good captain always goes down with his ship. What a good captain he was."
- "You! Grab me as many cryo canisters as you can find. Meanwhile, I've got a little project of my own."
- "You! Be a dear and get those cryo cans for me. I've got my hands full."
- "Blood infused ice. Hard enough to penetrate the hull of Scoria's Angel."
- "Look! Everything we need to make those ramsleds pierce a capital ship."
- "Locked! Blow the mag coils to get that gate open."
- "Gate's held shut with mag coils. Find them, and scrap them."
- "When I am done with you, there will be nothing left but a stain."
- "Ryoku, I never figured you for an ass-kisser. But while we're at it, you can kiss mine too."
- "Here we go again Yaiba...Ever wonder if things between us could have been different?"
- "Oh Ryoku, I never grow tired of bleeding you dry."
- Ryoku: "Vena. A simple provocation brings you right to my killing floor. A lesson for these Tenno; The vain are easily manipulated."
- "Oh Ryoku, would it seem more noble to you if I draped my ego in notions of honor and duty? Like you do?"
- "Come now Ryoku. Let's give old grandpa a grand finale."
- "I do have manners! Which is why, after I slit your throat and leave you gurgling in your own blood, I won't tell my Orion you said that."
- "Sully his legacy? Like me, he's an animal driven by vengeance and bloodlust. We both know it. Why won't you admit it?"
- "Oh Ryoku, you should know by now, I'm not giving you a choice."
- "If I was unworthy, you wouldn't be here, Ryoku. Just admit it. You need me."
- "You fight for honor and duty. I fight for pleasure, and I am going to enjoy every last moment of your end."
- "Any last words before we make this hurt?"
- "If it wasn't for the truce, I would have put you down for good, Ryoku. We both know it."
- "Your kunai will make an excellent gift for my Orion. You won't need them much longer."
- "Ryoku's crew will patch him up, but he will always know, Vena defeated him before the great and terrible Hunhow."
- "You did fight with honor, didn't you? Heal up, big boy."
- "You better purge those wounds quickly, Ryoku. I want to go again tomorrow."
- "Did you hear that, Orion? Did you hear how he squealed? We can make that happen again, and again, and again."

path: During The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima
During The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima
lines: - "Ahh... Haven't been stabbed like that... in a long time."
- "Ha ha. Good. I was getting tired of dusting this place."
- "Places to go, things to see, people to slaughter."
- "And what fresh hell will we bring today?"
- "Point me in a direction and let me work."
- "Ready the engines. It's time to reign death."
- "And here I was thinking you were about to let me rust."
- "If this is just another pointless errand, I will stab you."
- "No, no. It's fine. Take your time."
- "Did you know the human body has between 4.5 to 5.7 liters of blood in it?"
- "You don't need the rest of the crew, do you? We can do this with just us."
- "How do you manage to get all the blood out from between your floor tiles?"
- "They never quite prepare you for how much of your time in space is going to be spent standing around... waiting... to kill things."
- "Blood in zero gravity makes the prettiest little corpuscles. Want to see?"
- "There are actually three universal rules: Death, taxes, and 'I will make my own fun'. Understand?"
- "If we don't do something interesting soon, I will crash this ship into an asteroid just to watch you scream."
- "Why not. What else do I have to do today?"
- "I would like to see you try to make me."
- "It seems we have drawn attention. Oh no."
- "I am having the time of my life."
- "See? I don't need your help to do my job."
- "You bring me all the best kills."
- "This is what I'm capable of when you cut me loose."
- "Oh, I'm sorry, did you want that one?"
- "I wonder if Orion would have liked to see this."
- "Do you think they're squishy on the inside?"
- "I hate being this far away from my kills."
- "Explosions are more fun when they're juicy."
- "Orion would have made a better captain than you."
- "You have no idea how to fly this thing, do you?"
- "If you wanted to die, I would have happily obliged."
- "We are going to die, and I don't want to!"
- "Burning to death really isn't my thing."
- "I prefer my meat raw, not roasted."
- "The ship is on fire. Oh, you want me to do something about that?"
- "Do you smell burning? Oh, that's us."
- "Do you want to get sucked out into space? This is how you get sucked out into space."
- "Can I use your corpse to plug that hole?"
- "When I asked for a new puncture wound, I didn't mean in the ship."
- "I still need to breathe air. And a hundred credits says you do too."
- "Yes, yes. I put the damn fire out."
- "I had no interest in burning alive. Get back to work."
- "Can you focus on what we're supposed to be doing?"
- "I patched the hole. I almost broke a claw."
- "No, I did not use one of the crew to plug the hole. Don't look at me like that."
- "What? I didn't want to die like that, did you?"
- "Next time, it's you I'll be plugging the breach with."
- "Look! My insides are outside! How lovely!"
- "So much blood! I think it's all mine though."
- "I can put my claw all the way through my ribcage."
- "Do you want a taste before I die? It's better when it's fresh."
- "It's always work, work, work with you, isn't it?"
- "You never let me have any fun at all."
- "Whatever. I'll go murder someone else instead."
- "What? Are you expecting a thank you?"
- "But there is more blood to spill."
- "They were more useful as blood splatter than they were as crew."
- "We didn't need them anyway. It's fine."
- "Can I keep them as a trophy? Please."
- "Blood is blood. I don't care whose it is."
- "I'm doing my best not to judge you. And failing."
- "Do you think Orion would like this better?"
- "Vena. The Blood Witch. Careful, I come with sharp edges."
- "Let us go collect some debts. The fun way."
- "I am a debt worth bleeding for."
- "Tell me it's to be a slaughter."
- "Time is money. Money is blood. Let's go collect."
- "Oh, does someone need to die? Someones?"
- "I can taste the death on my lips already."
- "Finally! I am dying for a little mayhem."
- "The clouds will weep crimson in my wake!"
- "The entrails of our enemies will decorate my altar."
- "There is work to do. Let's be quick about it."
- "You better not be planning on handing me a gun."
- "Mm, they'll tell stories about me. If we leave any survivors."
- "I want to feel them die on my claws. Pretty please?"
- "Have you ever drained a heart dry? Watched it die?"
- "Working with you means I get to kill more things. I like it..."
- "A Void-Demon and The Blood-Wytch. A perfect match... made in hell."
- "Aww. Look at how puny you are."
- "I'm. Expensive. Leaving me here is expensive. Did you hear me?!"
- "You are either very wealthy or very stupid for leaving me here like this. Or both. Both are very likely. Mmm. I'm voting for both."
- "Do you have a habit of leaving your very deadly, beautiful, deadly, expensive, deadly, companions unattended on the regular?"
- "Two people can in theory kill better than one... Mmm. No."
- "Ooh. Can I stab you? Just a little? Only a little. I promise."
- "How much can I pay you to try a little of your blood?"
- "You're not just going to leave me parked here, are you? I'm not a Railjack!"
- "I'll just stand here stabbing myself in the thigh while you're gone."
- "At least give me something to kill. I'm going to get bored!"
- "Go. I'll be sharpening my claws, I suppose."
- "Every second I am standing here not spilling blood is a credit we haven't earned."
- "Our situation is currently mutually beneficial. And the only way it's mutually beneficial, is if it's current. Don't be gone long."
- "Every minute you're gone, you pay me in blood. I don't care whose."
- "What? But you're so... squishy without me!"
- "I'd ask if you had a plan, but then I remembered I don't care."
- "Didn't the Cephalon tell you to come back covered in blood? Well? Where is it?!"
- "Can we please be on our way now?"
- "I thought I was going to rust!"
- "We've wasted enough time. We have lives to end."
- "I am simply itching to slaughter something."
- "There you are! I thought you were going to leave me here forever. I've seen forever."
- "Did you bring me anyone fun to kill?"
- "I wish I could hollow you out and crawl inside your skull. So you know how it feels."
- "Once a puppet... always a puppet. Just more literal, now."
- "Oh, no, it's fine. I spent the whole time imagining I was drowning in blood."
- "I was just wondering, how long can you exist outside your body? Or does it go with you? No reason..."
- "Going to have to pick up the pace, if we're going to meet our quota!"
- "Where have you been? Those idiots are not going to stab themselves!"
- "When you do that, I can almost-almost-picture what your blood tastes like on my lips."
- "And you came back in one piece? Aw."
- "You're not even bleeding! Then what was the point?"
- "Did you bring me back anyone juicy?"
- "Shall we? We have places to be. People to kill."
- "My heart is positively pounding with excitement."
- "You will be nothing but ribbons of flesh when I am done!"
- "Do you think you frighten me?! I have seen the end of all life!"
- "Stop wasting my time! We both know how this ends!"
- "Maybe I'll murder my ancestor! Blink out of existence!"
- "A bag of blood on legs, that's all you idiots are to me!"
- "If you won't come to me, I'll come to you!"
- "I will tear you limb from limb!"
- "Your corpse will make such a pretty altar!"
- "Scream all you like! It won't save you!"
- "A little drop of you will stay with me. Forever."
- "I could slice into you for days!"
- "Feel my blades! So sweetly they carve!"
- "There are only two gods. Blood and money. You just died at the hands of one!"
- "I would eat your heart, if it were worthy!"
- "Give to me all that you are!"
- "Slaughter! Carnage! Viscera! You are my gods!"
- "Help me up. I want you to do that again."
- "When I get up, it'll be my turn."
- "Rivers of red, they flow from me!"
- "I'll finish it myself if you won't!"
- "You're right, I should probably get back to work."
- "Couldn't you see I was in the middle of bleeding?!"
- "I will hate you forever for that."
- "Fine! I suppose I'll have to take it out on other people."
- "But that was such a pretty wound..."
- "Don't clean it! It's better this way."
- "Leave the gore. I'm saving it for later."
- "I did that on purpose. I wanted to bleed."
- "Well if I can't bleed anymore, can you?"
- "What did I ever do to you?!"
- "Something is there. I hope it's killable."
- "Go there. So I don't have to."
- "Find whatever is there. I need to murder things."
- "If it doesn't die, I don't care."
- "Go look. Or whatever. I want to kill something."
- "Go look. If you make me, I'll kill you."
- "That might be important to you. It isn't to me, but you don't seem to care about that, do you?!"
- "Waste your time on that! Instead of killing! Of course!"
- "This thing that can't be murdered? Sure! Why not?!"
- "Investigate this? But-but why?! It can't bleed..."
- "Maybe it has something living in it that can die a horrible way?"
- "Just... go look, I don't know. I'm wasting my skills."
- "I think I will eat its heart."
- "That one has a debt to pay."
- "Are you thirsty? Let us drink of that one."
- "Aaah, look. A new victim has joined us."
- "I shall add that one to my altar next."
- "We are about to add a new line to our ledger."
- "They'll regret today." [laughing] "For the next few seconds."
- "This is much more fun than the Railjack!"
- "Wait, you can use guns on this?"
